about.title: About us 🦘

paragraphs.origin: The idea for this app came from a real need of our own. Every time we wanted to find an activity, we discovered how clunky it could be — hopping between endless websites, groups, pages and searches, and more than once just giving up because there was no time to look.
paragraphs.question: So we asked ourselves: why isn't there one place where you can find all the kids' activities near you, quickly and easily?
paragraphs.born: And that's how our app was born.
paragraphs.goal: Our goal is simple — to save you time, searching and headaches, and help you easily find the activity that's just right for you and your kids.
paragraphs.journey: We're still at the beginning of the journey, and we're always working, improving and adding new things to make the app better, more useful and easier to use.
paragraphs.hope: We hope we've helped you find something fun to do! 😊
paragraphs.share: If you're enjoying the app, we'd love for you to share it with friends, family and other parents.
paragraphs.feedback: And if you have a comment, idea, suggestion or even criticism — we always want to hear it. Your feedback is exactly what helps us get better.

Send forth children to explore the land
(or at least the nearest playground)
